Same framing, same size on the canvas, no skull, no text.
references: now_UI-PACK-LOCKED-N.png (what is in the game), UI-PACK-LOCKED-B.png and UI-PACK-LOCKED-R.png (the look to match)

asset: Primm's Castle dungeon map (redo for the new layout)

New layout from ref plan-primm-castle: the gate on the left, six columns of rooms (2, 4, 3, 3, 4, 4), the Model Room on the right; a clear walkway for EVERY line of the plan, always leading right; each room an open diorama with an empty round landing spot in front. Keep the rooms' looks (pantry, hedge courtyard, hall of mirrors, archive, clocktower, vault). No lettering.
references: plan-primm-castle.jpg (the new layout), now_MAP-PC.jpg (the style and the rooms to keep)

asset: The Pantry Mimic (Bestiary portrait, also its battle portrait)
in-game use: The Gilded Pantry's optional fight in Primm's Castle; the Collection Book
replaces: The Echo of the Doppelganger's picture stands in.
description: A gilded pantry cupboard that is alive: tall, white and gold, one door hanging open like a mouth, jars and a chewed cookbook on its shelves, two round preserve-jar lids for eyes, a ladle for a tongue, small clawed cabinet feet. It is trying to look like a chef: a toque sits crooked on top and an apron is tied round its middle. Mischievous, not scary. Painterly, bold shapes, warm kitchen light, the same style as the other Bestiary portraits (ref). Square, the creature centred, plain soft pantry background.
references: now_BST-ECHO-OF-THE-DOPPELGANGER.jpg (the stand-in; the style and framing to match)

asset: Auntie Alembic's brewing scene (the centre of her shop)
in-game use: Auntie Alembic's shop: the middle of 'The brew' panel, in place of the small cauldron
description: Auntie Alembic (ref: grey-haired, green headscarf, paint-splashed apron, warm smile) stirring a big copper cauldron with a long wooden spoon, seen from the front, half figure behind the pot. Four streams of glowing liquid pour into it from glass pipes above: red, blue, green and violet (the four Paths), and coloured steam curls up. The scene feels alive: bubbles, sparks, a happy face. Same painterly style as her shop. Transparent background, nothing cropped at the edges, no lettering.
references: now_UI-CAULDRON.png (the cauldron to keep), now_V-ALEMBIC.jpg (her look), now_alembic_shop.jpg (where it goes)

in-game use: Auntie Alembic's shop: the four essence jars (the game fills and tints the liquid behind the glass)
replaces: A jar drawn by the game (ref now_alembic_shop)
description: One EMPTY apothecary jar, seen straight from the front: clear glass with a soft highlight down the left side and a darker rim, a short neck, a cork stopper, a thin brass band round the neck with a blank oval tag. The inside must be truly transparent (see-through glass, no liquid, no background), because the game draws the coloured liquid behind it and a number on it. Painterly, bold outline, the same style as the shop. The jar fills the frame with a small margin. No lettering.
references: now_alembic_shop.jpg (the drawn jars it replaces, and their size)
